wins: Achieved non-zero total reward indicating partial task completion

fails: Success rate at 0.00% indicates no full objective completion

skill_cards.if_condition: When an episode yields partial reward but no success
skill_cards.then_action: Perform a step-by-step post-mortem to identify the last successful action and the first failing action, then add a corrective hypothesis

skill_cards.if_condition: When mentor calls exceed 5 in a single episode
skill_cards.then_action: Pause and create a decision checklist to reduce reliance on assistance

skill_cards.if_condition: When only one episode exists for a run
skill_cards.then_action: Run at least 3 additional episodes with varied parameters to validate stability of strategies
